what.text: This page follows refugees from Somalia living in Zambia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4719 Somali refugees in Zambia, 0.5% of all refugees from Somalia.
Kenya and Ethiopia host the most Somali refugees, followed by Uganda and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia in periods from 1982 to 2025, at war level in most of the years since 2006, with Al-Shabaab among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Somalia from 2019 to 2021 and in 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1975 at 110 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2015 to 2016 and 2018 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Zambia.
These are year-end totals for Zambia only, reported to UNHCR.
